accounting_label: historical replay on Gemini's own recorded books and settlements; no order was sent
descriptive_only: no threshold is selected, no cell is promoted, and no strategy parameter is touched
favorite_definition: the dearer EXECUTABLE side, and only when its executable ask is >= 0.50; a side with no recorded ask is not a favorite at any price

fee_model.reconciliation: published schedule; NOT reconciled against our own authenticated fills, so zero-fee breakeven is reported beside it

leadership_definition: fixed precedence MID -> BID_ONLY -> ASK_ONLY -> UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN contributes no leadership observation and gaps are counted, never interpolated
